<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:lineSpacingExtra="4dp" android:text="@string/module_one_scope_items" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.BodyMedium" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" android:text="@string/batch_form_title" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.TitleMedium" android:textStyle="bold" />

<TextView android:id="@+id/text_expense_status" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:text="@string/expense_status_idle" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.BodyMedium" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" android:text="@string/spoilage_title" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.TitleMedium" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:text="@string/spoilage_caption" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.BodyMedium" />
<EditText android:id="@+id/edit_spoilage_kilos" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:hint="@string/hint_spoilage_kilos" android:inputType="numberDecimal" tools:text="15" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="12dp" android:text="@string/label_loss_type" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.BodyMedium" />
<Spinner android:id="@+id/spinner_loss_type" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" />
<Button android:id="@+id/button_log_spoilage" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="16dp" android:text="@string/button_log_spoilage" android:textAllCaps="false" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/text_spoilage_status" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:text="@string/spoilage_status_idle" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.BodyMedium" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" android:text="@string/results_title" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.TitleMedium" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/text_active_lot_summary" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:lineSpacingExtra="4dp" android:minLines="12" android:text="@string/no_active_lot_placeholder" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.BodyMedium" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" android:text="@string/all_lots_title" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.TitleMedium" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/text_all_lots_summary" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:lineSpacingExtra="4dp" android:minLines="4" android:text="@string/no_lots_placeholder" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.BodyMedium" />
<TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="24dp" android:text="@string/journal_title" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.TitleMedium" android:textStyle="bold" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/text_journal_summary" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:lineSpacingExtra="4dp" android:minLines="6" android:text="@string/no_journal_placeholder" android:textAppearance="@style/TextAppearance.Material3.BodyMedium" />

<resources> <string name="app_name">Kilgi</string> <string name="module_one_title">Module 1: Landed Cost Procurement & Inventory Ledger</string> <string name="module_one_subtitle">Room-backed prototype for Carbon Market vegetable lots with perpetual inventory costing and automated double-entry journals.</string> <string name="module_one_scope">Functional requirements covered in this screen:</string> <string name="module_one_scope_items">• Baseline lot creation with provider, kilos, unit price, and freight
• Dynamic expense capitalization into inventory
• Normal vs abnormal spoilage handling
• Live total capitalized cost, net usable kilos, and true cost per kilo
• Stored balancing journal entries for each accountable event</string> <string name="batch_form_title">Baseline lot creation</string> <string name="batch_form_caption">Capture the morning delivery and automatically post the initial double-entry capitalization of the vegetable batch.</string> <string name="hint_provider_id">Provider ID</string> <string name="hint_provider_name">Provider / supplier name</string> <string name="hint_vegetable_type">Vegetable type</string> <string name="hint_total_sacks">Total sacks purchased</string> <string name="hint_raw_kilos">Total raw kilograms received</string> <string name="hint_base_unit_price">Base unit price per kilo</string> <string name="label_purchase_payment_source">Purchase payment source</string> <string name="hint_standard_freight">Standard freight / shipping cost</string> <string name="label_freight_payment_source">Freight payment source</string> <string name="button_create_lot">Create lot and post opening journal</string> <string name="batch_status_idle">No lot selected yet. Create or load a lot to begin.</string> <string name="batch_created_message">Lot %1$s created and capitalized successfully.</string> <string name="batch_status_loaded">Loaded lot %1$s.</string> <string name="active_lot_title">Active / selected lot</string> <string name="active_lot_caption">Use the current lot ID to add later expenses, review valuation, or log spoilage against an existing batch.</string> <string name="hint_selected_lot_id">Selected lot ID</string> <string name="button_refresh_lot">Load selected lot</string> <string name="expense_title">Additional expenses sub-module</string> <string name="expense_caption">Append unique hauling, toll, repair, preservation, or sorting-related costs to the selected lot and capitalize them immediately.</string> <string name="hint_expense_label">Expense label</string> <string name="hint_expense_amount">Expense amount</string> <string name="label_expense_payment_source">Expense payment source</string> <string name="button_add_expense">Add expense and post journal</string> <string name="expense_status_idle">No additional expense posted yet.</string> <string name="expense_added_message">Expense "%1$s" capitalized successfully.</string> <string name="spoilage_title">Spoilage / waste revaluation</string> <string name="spoilage_caption">Normal shrinkage reduces usable kilos and inflates future unit cost. Abnormal loss posts an explicit write-off to account 50200.</string> <string name="hint_spoilage_kilos">Kilos lost</string> <string name="label_loss_type">Loss type</string> <string name="button_log_spoilage">Log spoilage</string> <string name="spoilage_status_idle">No spoilage logged yet.</string> <string name="spoilage_logged_message">Normal shrinkage of %1$s logged.
